cmd:alerts.note: :alerts (:att, :attention) toggles the notification browser. The numbered attention queue (slice 4) is the "Attention queue…" action in the Go menu and palette.

cmd:delete.note: :delete (:del) moves the session to the trash like DD; run from the palette it asks first

cmd:pause-soft.note: :pause soft downgrades the HARD pause of the open session to SOFT

cmd:provider-clear-hold.note: Expose ClearProviderUsageHold for the selected session's provider after an account switch.

key:<Space>gX.note: opens the trash browser (ListDeletedSessions) grouped by time period; also Go menu, palette

key:<Space>gq.note: opens the question modal for the open session, else the first session with a question; also Session menu, right-click

key:<Space>hs.note: downgrades the open session's HARD pause to SOFT (SetOperatorPause); refuses when it is not HARD

key:<Space>hu.note: Expose ClearProviderUsageHold for the selected session's provider after an account switch.

key:<Space>n.note: notification browser: desktop toasts and session completed/failed/waiting transitions, active first then history; also Go menu, palette. The numbered attention queue (slice 4) is the "Attention queue…" action in the Go menu and palette.

key:DD.note: moves the session to the trash (DeleteSession); DD is the double-tap confirmation, so menus, the palette and buttons ask first; refuses Running, Starting and Archived sessions like the TUI

key:U.note: unarchives the list-cursor session (the open one without a cursor) in the Archived view; also Session menu, right-click, palette

key:gr.note: recent completions: the six latest Completed, Failed or Interrupted sessions; Enter opens one

module:ui/overlay/notification_browser.r.note: notification browser and recent completions, with the modal geometry keys (G1)

module:ui/overlay/question_modal.rs.note: inline banner plus the question modal

module:ui/overlay/trash_browser.rs.note: Archived view plus the trash browser

overlay-ref:notifications.note: j/k, g/G, x, N, Enter, Esc/q, Space N and Space ;; Ctrl+Arrows move, Ctrl+Shift+Arrows resize and Ctrl+0 resets the dialog (G1's modal geometry, saved per dialog)

overlay-ref:question-insert.note: type, Enter or Ctrl/Cmd-Enter submits, Shift-Enter adds a line, Esc returns to the options; submit-on-Enter is fixed on (no setting yet)

overlay-ref:question-normal.note: j/k, Space, 1-9, Enter/Backspace, i, Ctrl/Cmd-Enter, d, Esc/q as in the TUI

overlay-ref:trash.note: j/k, G, U restores, D purges (the desktop asks for a second D within 5 s, the TUI purges at once), Esc/q, Space N, Space ;

overlay:archive-zone-session-list.note: archived sessions in the Archive zone with j/k, gg/G, Enter/l and U to restore; gs / gj / ga jump between the Main, Jobs (G2) and Archive zones, shown as the list header’s zone tabs
